source: Sancarlo and Paul 2026, ZooNova 54, Fig. 13: the left of two strict consensus trees of tyrannosauroids (the caption reads them right to left: equal weights, then extended implied weights); rectangular, root left, thick lines, specimen numbers before some names. The right tree (the same taxa, another analysis) is excluded. Image: census 2 figure (2185x1205 px), the embedded raster.
region_note: the left tree; the right tree is the other analysis of the same taxa
license: unverified: no licence statement in the text held
names_note: no matrix held; list = the printed tip names of the left tree as printed, abbreviations included ('A.altai', 'T?mcraeensis', 'T.rex'), the specimen tips with their numbers ('CMNH7541 Nanotyrannus', 'HRS08') and the lower-case higher taxa 'ornithomimosauria' and 'maniraptora'
gold_note: Left tree of the two, read by eye at 2-3x; no clade names are printed. Polytomies: Sinotyrannus-Yutyrannus-the Kileskus clade; Aviatyrannis-Dilong-the Stokesosaurus clade-the rest; Stokesosaurus-Juratyrant-Eotyrannus and Teratophoneus-Dynamoterror-Lythronax (in both the stem enters at the middle tip's level and runs on as its branch, read as entering the node, as in earlier batches). 42 tips, 4 polytomies (3, 4, 3, 3 children). Sample 6 case (census 2 extended to draw 120, seed 20261231). Topology transcribed from the figure image and checked node by node; topology only.
